# CBDB-Desktop: Association Pairs label revisions, 2026-10-26

The first form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table (form code LAAP). Forms are being reviewed in alphabetical order. Changes are in the Association Pairs form's index.html only. The page script was syntax-checked. **Not yet tested in the running app**; spacing and fit are still to be checked.

## How to revert a label

Every label below lives in the T translation object near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified. To go back to the earlier wording, change the value of the key named in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. Each changed line has a comment naming its FormLabels row (for example // LAAP 6).

For the five controls marked **†**, the English text is also written directly in the HTML element. setLanguage('english') overwrites it when the page loads, so editing T.english is enough. Change the HTML text too only to keep the two in step.

## Notes on individual changes

**LBL-3.** The Access wording matches the 1-node / 2-node terminology already used in the Oct 13 report and the user's guide notes.

**LBL-4.** FormLabels gives "From" / "To" and 始年 / 終年 without colons. The colons were kept in all three languages because the labels precede input boxes; LAN 5 and 6 also have them.

**LBL-5.** LAAP 9 has 詢查 / 询查. **查詢 / 查询 was chosen instead** (as in LAN 13). The table row should be corrected.

**LBL-6.** LAAP covers only Save to GIS and Save to Pajek. Neo4j, Gephi and UCINet were changed to 保存于 as well, so that all Save buttons on the form match. **于 is used in both Chinese modes, by decision**, although traditional text would more often use 於. The 保存 in the traditional block replaces 儲存.

**LBL-7.** "Associations" (社會關係) follows LAAP 14. With Include Kinship relations ticked, this tab also lists kinship edges. Revert if the name proves misleading. 社會關係的人 is also noticeably longer than 人物; check it fits the tab.

**LBL-8.** Follows BIO 2 and the 2026-10-16 correction (指數, not 索引).

**LBL-9.** btnSelectDynasty had no translation key and was not set in setLanguage, so it read "Select Dynasties" in every language. A selectDynasties key was added in all three blocks and a line in setLanguage. There is no FormLabels row; 選擇朝代 / 选择朝代 follows the 選擇… pattern of LAAP 7 and 8.

**LBL-10.** updateDynastyDisplay() is now called at the end of setLanguage. Before this, after dynasties were chosen, the summary next to Select Dynasties ("3 Dynasties, starting with …" / "3個朝代，起於…") stayed in the language that was active when they were chosen.

## Access options not carried over

- **LAAP 3, "Allow 1-node Intermediaries."** Judged unnecessary. 1-node intermediaries always run in the HTML version, including in 2-node queries. No control added; the row can be retired.
- **LAAP 5, "Include Node-node relations" (包括所有的中間關係).** No counterpart in the HTML or in the Go code reviewed so far. Its effect in the VBA is not yet known; it may have controlled whether edges between intermediaries were included.

## Not changed

- English "Run Query", "Save to GIS", "Save to Pajek", "People"; 朝代 (BIO 27).
- The language buttons (LAAP 12, 13): the HTML uses EN / 繁 / 简 buttons rather than Access's toggle, so these rows don't apply.
- Labels with no FormLabels row: Person 1 / Person 2 headings, Person List, Search Options, Date Filter, No Date Filter, All Dynasties, Import List, Clear List, Recall IDs, Store Person IDs, Export Query Results, and the page title. LAN 61 ("Import People", 輸入人名) is the nearest entry for Import List.
